command_line:
set -eu
userbase="$PWD/.caper-userbase"
export PYTHONUSERBASE="$userbase"
python3 -m pip install --user --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-cache-dir "caper==2.2.3" "miniwdl==0.7.0" "autouri==0.2.4" "pyhocon==0.3.63" "humanfriendly==9.1" "pyopenssl==19.1.0" "cryptography==3.3.2" "protobuf==3.19.6"
export PATH="$userbase/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$userbase/lib/python3.6/site-packages"
archive="OpenJDK11U-jre_x64_linux_hotspot_11.0.32_9.tar.gz"
baseurl="https://github.com/adoptium/temurin11-binaries/releases/download/jdk-11.0.32%2B9"
wget -q -O "$archive" "$baseurl/$archive"
wget -q -O "$archive.sha256.txt" "$baseurl/$archive.sha256.txt"
sha256sum -c "$archive.sha256.txt"
mkdir jre11
tar -xzf "$archive" -C jre11 --strip-components=1
cat > input.json <<JSON
{
  "atac.pipeline_type": "atac",
  "atac.genome_tsv": "https://storage.googleapis.com/encode-pipeline-genome-data/genome_tsv/v4/hg38.tsv",
  "atac.fastqs_rep1_R1": ["/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79327981/inputs/dataset_2d599c57-8b14-4fe1-9ade-9dc05b36557a.dat"],
  "atac.fastqs_rep1_R2": ["/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79327981/inputs/dataset_817c85ac-7fad-4bf2-85ed-d8cc5a9156ff.dat"],
  "atac.paired_end": true,
  "atac.auto_detect_adapter": true,
  "atac.title": "encode.atac.pipeline.q1",
  "atac.description": "Human paired-end ATAC-seq sample"
}
JSON
dry_status=0
"$userbase/bin/caper" run   --backend local   --ignore-womtool   --dry-run   --local-out-dir "$PWD/caper-out"   --local-loc-dir "$PWD/caper-loc"   --max-concurrent-tasks 1   --disable-call-caching   --str-label encode_atac_pipeline_q1   -i "$PWD/input.json"   /software/atac-seq-pipeline/atac.wdl > dryrun.log 2>&1 || dry_status=$?
if test "$dry_status" -ne 0; then
  cat dryrun.log >&2
  exit "$dry_status"
fi
find "$PWD/caper-loc" -type f -name backend.conf -print -quit > backend.path
find "$PWD/caper-loc" -type f -name workflow_opts.json -print -quit > options.path
find "$PWD/caper-loc" -type f -name labels.json -print -quit > labels.path
find "$PWD/caper-loc" -type f -name input.local.json -print -quit > inputs.path
backend=
options=
labels=
localized_inputs=
if IFS= read -r backend < backend.path; then :; else echo "backend.conf not found" >&2; cat dryrun.log >&2; exit 1; fi
if IFS= read -r options < options.path; then :; else echo "workflow_opts.json not found" >&2; cat dryrun.log >&2; exit 1; fi
if IFS= read -r labels < labels.path; then :; else echo "labels.json not found" >&2; cat dryrun.log >&2; exit 1; fi
input_json="$PWD/input.json"
if IFS= read -r localized_inputs < inputs.path; then input_json="$localized_inputs"; fi
jar="$PWD/cromwell-82.jar"
wget -q -O "$jar" https://github.com/broadinstitute/cromwell/releases/download/82/cromwell-82.jar
run_status=0
"$PWD/jre11/bin/java"   -Xmx8G   -XX:ParallelGCThreads=1   -DLOG_LEVEL=INFO   -DLOG_MODE=standard   "-Dconfig.file=$backend"   -jar "$jar" run /software/atac-seq-pipeline/atac.wdl   -i "$input_json"   -o "$options"   -l "$labels"   -m "$PWD/cromwell-metadata.json" > cromwell.out 2>&1 || run_status=$?
if test "$run_status" -ne 0; then
  tail -200 cromwell.out >&2
  exit "$run_status"
fi
find "$PWD/caper-out" -type f -name qc.json -print -quit > qc.path
qc_source=
if IFS= read -r qc_source < qc.path; then
  cp "$qc_source" qc.json
else
  tail -200 cromwell.out >&2
  exit 1
fi
test -s qc.json
